data.title: Sam Poser Maintains Hold on On While Raising Price Target to $31 on Innovation Upside Amid Execution Risks
data.description:
Analyst Sam Poser from Williams Trading maintained a Hold rating on On Holding AG and increased the price target to $31.00 from $27.00.

Sam Poser has given his Hold rating due to a combination of factors tied to both opportunity and execution risk. He recognizes meaningful upside from On’s strong product innovation pipeline, new category expansion into global football and golf, and a shift to U.S.‑dollar reporting, and he reflects this optimism by revising his price target upward from $27 to $31.

At the same time, he remains cautious about the company’s ability to reach its ambitious 2029 revenue and margin goals, particularly given uneven performance at key wholesale partners and heavy reliance on athletic specialty accounts. Poser also doubts that On can deliver the implied SG&A leverage as new stores may be less productive, and sustained investment will be required to support wholesale growth, leading him to balance the long‑term promise with near‑term execution risks in a Hold stance.
